title: xo project identity
description: Identity and durable provenance for one cowork folder. Three writers contribute to this document and each writes a key-scoped merge — no writer may touch another's keys (docs/syncplan.md §5.1): `visualizer/sinks/project_json.fill_identity` owns `schema`, `pid`, `name`, `owner_user_id`, `created_at` and is the only place that drops `_template`; `project_layout._upsert_metadata` owns `display_name` and `description` (and seeds `name`/`created_at` at scaffold time, because it is what creates the file); the git refresher owns `git`.

$schema.description: Editor hint — points at this schema file.

schema.description: Record schema version; 2 is current. 2 only *declares* `display_name`, `description` and `git` — keys that were already being written into a document declared `additionalProperties: false`, so every project.json on disk failed its own validator. A version-1 document is therefore structurally a valid version-2 document and is accepted unchanged: no writer rewrites the version of an existing file, so refusing 1 would just move the same defect to a different key.

_template.description: Present and true on a fresh template. The first agent to boot must populate identity fields and remove this flag.

pid.description: UUID v4. Generated once on first boot. Never regenerated — it is the identity that survives a clone, a rename and a restore.

name.description: Folder name at mint time. NOT the lookup key — every consumer keys on the directory name, which this may have drifted from after a rename.

display_name.description: Human-readable name the user typed at creation. Written by `project_layout._upsert_metadata`; defaults to the project id when the caller supplies none.

description.description: One-line summary the user typed at creation. Written by `project_layout._upsert_metadata`; empty string when the caller supplies none. The projects list falls back to the project's own docs when this is empty.

owner_user_id.description: Stable user identifier of the project owner: the authenticated user_id, else CODER_WORKSPACE_OWNER_NAME, else "local". Never overwritten once a real value is stored — that would silently reassign someone else's project. The single exception is the "local" placeholder, which identifies nobody and was written identically by every unauthenticated Space; it is upgraded once, when a real identity becomes available (2026-09-08).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of first boot.

git.description: Durable git provenance, refreshed from the project's OWN repo. It lives here as well as in the machine-local `projects.json` cache because a snapshot excludes `.git` but includes this file (`xo_projects_sync/tarball.py:36-42`) — so a restore destroys the directory the remote URL was read from while preserving `project.json`. Provenance kept only in `.git` does not survive the one operation it exists to describe. Absent until the git refresher has run.

remote_url.description: `remote.origin.url` with any `user:token@` userinfo stripped. Null when the folder is not a repo, git is unavailable, or there is no origin.

default_branch.description: Short default branch name. Null when undeterminable (no commits, detached HEAD with no origin/HEAD).
